welcome.title: Welcome to Gachapon!
welcome.text: Pull cards, complete your collection and send your best cards into battle in the campaign.

tokens.title: Tokens & pulls
tokens.text: Every pull costs one <token>token</token>. Your tokens regenerate automatically over time, up to a cap. Pull one card at a time, or several at once with the multi-pull.

rarities.title: Rarities & pity
rarities.text: Five rarities, from <common>common</common> to <legendary1>legendary</legendary1>, plus brilliant and holographic variants that give more <dust>dust</dust>. The pity guarantee gets you a <legendary2>legendary</legendary2> after a certain number of pulls.

duplicates.title: Duplicates & dust
duplicates.text: A duplicate is automatically turned into <dust>dust</dust>. That currency is spent in the daily shop, on wishes and on upgrading your cards: no pull is ever wasted.

shop.title: Shop
shop.text: Spend your <dust>dust</dust> in the daily shop to target specific cards, or keep the cards of your dreams as wishes to buy them outright. The shop also offers <token>token</token> packs and <energy>energy</energy> refills.

campaign.title: Team & campaign
campaign.text: Build a team with your cards and dive into the campaign: battles that earn <gold>gold</gold>, experience and equipment to push ever further.
